name: bloctime.yuma
description: Yuma consensus where validator stake is BlocTime. A validator's voice is its BLOC voting power (held + delegated) — BLOC is dollars x seconds locked, so a long lock outweighs a big wallet. Validators weight miners; the stake-weighted kappa-quantile clips outliers; miners earn by clipped rank, validators by EMA bonds. Same integer maths in Solidity (contracts/yuma/YumaBlocTime.sol) and Python (yuma.py), pinned by fixtures/cases.json.

rules.consensus: C_j = max c : sum of normalised stake with W_ij >= c reaches kappa
rules.incentive: I_j = sum_i s_i min(W_ij, C_j), normalised
rules.bonds: B_ij = alpha * share of miner j's clipped rank + (1 - alpha) * B_ij
rules.emission: ownerCut off the top; minerShare of the rest by I, remainder by D; dust to owner
